traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills widely spaced, and have a waxy texture. Initially, the gills are pale greyish, becoming darker with age and developing dark brown to blackish spots

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: convex when young, later flattening, and sometimes developing a central depression, surface is smooth, slimy when wet, and shiny when dry, with a coppery color, with purplish tinges
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: convex when young, later flattening, and sometimes developing a central depression, surface is smooth, slimy when wet, and shiny when dry, with a coppery color, with purplish tinges

traits.label: Hymenium Attachment
traits.text: Decurrent
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Decurrent

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: cylindrical, often slightly tapering towards the base, and concolorous with the cap, solid at first but becomes hollow with age, with a sticky surface when moist

traits.label: Spore print

traits.text: Edible but not highly regarded due to its slimy texture and somewhat bland taste
